namespace.description: The Service Bus namespace's resource ID (/subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<group>/providers/Microsoft.ServiceBus/namespaces/<name>), or its name

subscription.description: The namespace's subscription when namespace is a name; default: the connection's only subscription

queue.description: The queue whose dead letters these are

topic.description: The topic, with topicSubscription, instead of queue

topicSubscription.description: The topic's subscription whose dead letters these are

count.description: Dead-lettered messages to peek, from the oldest

maxBytes.description: Bytes of each message body to show
